title: OTel collector test fixture: wait for health endpoint, not a fixed sleep, and pick free ports
answers: OTel collector fixture flaky in tests, spans missing because collector not ready yet
tracing OTLP export test fails intermittently with port already in use
how does the otel_collector pytest fixture know the collector is ready
why does the collector test wait on a health check instead of sleeping
body:
Symptom: OTLP/trace export tests against the Docker collector fail intermittently, with spans missing or the collector not yet accepting connections, or ports clashing between runs.
Root cause: tests/tracing/conftest.py:otel_collector used random.randint(20000, 30000) for the OTLP port and a fixed time.sleep(5) before yielding, with the config piped through bash echo into docker run stdin.
Fix pattern: take OTLP and health ports from find_free_port(), ensure they differ, enable the health_check extension, and poll http://127.0.0.1:<health_port>/ until it returns 200 within a deadline. On early process exit or timeout, raise with the captured collector log file contents.
Constraints: the container-side health port (13133 in the health_check extension endpoint) must match the container port of the -p mapping. Docker pull retries stay in place. Applies only to the Docker-based otel_collector fixture.
applies: Test fixtures in tests/tracing that start the OpenTelemetry collector container.
says: Tracing export tests fail intermittently because spans are missing before collector readiness
Automated trace verification tests crash randomly due to network port collisions between runs
Trace tests fail when the collector drops initial traces during fixed startup delays
Ensure tracing tests poll collector health status instead of relying on fixed pauses
search: The Docker-based otel_collector fixture in tests/tracing/conftest.py must determine readiness by polling the health_check extension endpoint rather than using a fixed time.sleep. Distinct ports for OTLP and health checks must be allocated via find_free_port(), polling http://127.0.0.1:<health_port>/ until HTTP 200 is returned or raising with collector logs on timeout or exit. The container-side health port 13133 must match the port mapping, existing Docker pull retries must be retained, and the rule applies to test_export_to_otel_collector.
